name: Clerky
description: Clerky provides guided legal paperwork for startup formation, fundraising, hiring, equity compensation, commercial agreements, corporate maintenance, banking, and compliance.
agentUseSummary: Clerky cannot currently be connected as a Relay agent provider because it publishes no supported public account API, delegated OAuth contract, API key, remote MCP service, or distributable integration schema. Its product is an interactive, prerequisite-gated legal workflow, while documented Pulley and banking connections are provider-operated partner integrations rather than public agent authority. Relay will not automate legal paperwork, reuse browser sessions, infer private endpoints, or relabel a partner workflow as a native API.

blocked.label: Connect a Clerky account
blocked.description: Clerky does not publish a supported OAuth, API-key, remote MCP, or other delegated account contract for Relay to implement.

blocked.label: Access legal or company data
blocked.description: Entities, founders, officers, directors, shareholders, cap tables, documents, signatures, financings, hires, equity grants, tax IDs, banking details, invoices, collaborators, and audit trails are blocked without a supported authenticated account API.

blocked.label: Perform legal or filing actions
blocked.description: Formation, filings, board actions, stock issuances, fundraising documents, hiring agreements, equity compensation, signatures, bank applications, amendments, and other consequential workflows are blocked.

blocked.label: Use unsupported automation
blocked.description: Relay will not automate the dashboard, reuse browser sessions, capture credentials, scrape legal records, reverse-engineer private endpoints, or relabel Pulley, banking, perks, or attorney workflows as a public Clerky API.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported customer-authenticated Clerky account API, remote MCP service, or written distributable integration contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No customer-authenticated Clerky account operation is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No customer-authenticated Clerky account operation is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Clerky publishes interactive legal-product and help-center workflows plus provider-operated integrations such as Pulley and banking applications, but no public account API, OAuth application contract, customer API key, remote MCP service, stable operation schemas, or least-privilege revocation contract. Its own access model deliberately gates consequential legal products on completed prerequisite paperwork.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not expose Connect, request account credentials, publish runtime tools, automate the Clerky dashboard, or treat Pulley/banking integrations as public API authority. Reconsider only if Clerky publishes a supported customer-authenticated account API, remote MCP service, or written distributable integration contract with stable schemas, least-privilege authorization, revocation, and legal-workflow safeguards.

evidence.supports: Clerky documents an interactive product-access model that unlocks formation, fundraising, hiring, equity, commercial, and maintenance workflows only after prerequisite legal paperwork is completed. It does not document public API authentication or stable callable schemas.

Clerky documents a customer-installed Pulley partnership that synchronizes cap-table data through Clerky's Integrations page. It does not expose a public Clerky API, delegated Relay authentication, operation schemas, or independent least-privilege credentials.

Clerky documents that even support access to customer account data is disabled by default and must be explicitly enabled in the interactive account. Relay will not infer broader automated authority or reuse a signed-in session.
